seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Divas Hit the Road (花儿与少年) is a reality television show which is produced by Hunan Broadcast Station. In season 3, the cast consists of Bolin Chen, Yo Yang, Zhang Ruo Yun, Ji Bo Ran, Na Zha, Lai Yu Meng, Jiang Shu Ying, Lareina. These youthful souls will begin their adventurous backpack journey without the help of their managers and assistants.
